description: This file defines serializable classes and utility methods for handling Consul-related membership and silo registration data within Orleans, utilizing JSON serialization/deserialization, and converting data between internal representations and Consul KV pairs.

classes.name: ConsulSiloRegistration
classes.description: A serializable representation of a silo's registration information for Consul, including properties such as Hostname, Port, Status, and suspicion data.

classes.name: SuspectingSilo
classes.description: A serializable object representing a record of suspicion about a silo, including an identifier and timestamp.

methods.name: FormatVersionKey
methods.description: Generates a version key string based on deployment ID and root folder.

methods.name: FormatDeploymentKVPrefix
methods.description: Creates a deployment key prefix for Consul KV entries, optionally including a root folder.

methods.name: FormatDeploymentSiloKey
methods.description: Formats a specific silo key within a deployment for Consul KV storage.

methods.name: FormatSiloIAmAliveKey
methods.description: Creates a key for the 'IAmAlive' status of a silo.

methods.name: FromKVPairs
methods.description: Creates a ConsulSiloRegistration object from given KVPair data and optional IAmAlive KVPair.

methods.name: FromMembershipEntry
methods.description: Converts a MembershipEntry object into a ConsulSiloRegistration, linking internal data with external KV representation.

methods.name: ToKVPair
methods.description: Serializes a ConsulSiloRegistration into a KVPair for storage in Consul.

methods.name: ToIAmAliveKVPair
methods.description: Creates a KVPair for the 'IAmAlive' timestamp of a silo.

methods.name: ToMembershipEntry
methods.description: Converts a ConsulSiloRegistration back into a MembershipEntry object for internal use.
